newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Olympic Steel cut by DMG.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Olympic Steel cut by DMG.

text.p: Olympic Steel Inc was downgraded to accumulate from buy at brokerage Deutsche Morgan Grenfell on Tuesday.
-- Shares slipped 1/2 to 15-1/8 in early trading.
-- 1997 EPS lowered from $1.57 to $1.10 and 1998 from $2.00 to $1.45 for 1998. Says believes Q2 consensus of $0.43 a share will fall in the near-term and pressure shares.
-- Cited lower gross margin due to weaker automotive business and said recent strike at Chrysler Corp hurt shipments of high-margin product.
-- "Of the service centers we follow, Olympic is the most exposed to a downturn in auto business," report said.
